note: Built to BREAK routing, not confirm it. Categories: under-specified, two-skills-in-sequence, meta-route-down, harder-negatives, boundary-straddlers. Some expected_primary labels are genuinely contestable — that is deliberate; a router disagreeing with a soft label is a finding about description clarity, not necessarily a bug. 'soft' flags evals where reasonable humans would disagree on the primary.
